title: Preparation of Adult Rat Ventricular Myocytes for FRET Imaging Experiments
author: Robert Harvey
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ba8hiht6
materials: Switch to a Ca 2+ -free PSS containing collagenase type 2 (~1 mg/ml,) and protease type XIV (~0.1 mg/ml, Sigma-Aldrich) and continue to perfuse the heart for 6 to 7 minutes.

steps.title: Anesthetize the rat
steps.instruction: Anesthetize an adult Sprague-Dawley rat (250-300 mg) via intraperitoneal injection of pentobarbital (150 mg/kg).

steps.title: Harvest the heart
steps.instruction: Once a deep plane of anesthesia is reached (loss of corneal and toe pinch reflexes), remove the chest skin and open the chest cavity by cutting along both sides of the sternum with scissors. Remove the heart and place it in physiologic saline solution (PSS) [140 mM NaCl, 5.4 mM KCl, 2.5 mM MgSO4, 1.5 mM CaCl2, 11 mM glucose, and 5.5 mM HEPES (pH 7.4)] at 37°C.

steps.title: Clear blood from coronary arteries
steps.instruction: Gently massage the heart by hand to expel excess blood from the ventricles. Insert a cannula attached to a syringe into the aorta and perfuse the coronary arteries with Ca2+-containing PSS until the coronaries are rinsed free of blood.

steps.title: Perform Langendorff perfusion
steps.instruction: Attach the heart to a Langendorff apparatus by cannulating the aorta and perfuse with Ca2+ containing PSS at 37°C.

substeps.instruction: Maintain a flow rate of 5 ml/min for approximately 5 minutes using constant pressure.
Switch the perfusion solution to Ca2+-free PSS for 5 minutes, ensuring the heart stops contracting to confirm all Ca2+ containing solution is rinsed.

steps.title: Dissect and mince ventricles
steps.instruction: Remove the heart from the Langendorff apparatus and place it in a dissecting dish containing KB solution [110 mM K+ glutamate, 10 mM KH2PO4, 25 mM KCl, 1.2 mM MgSO4, 20 mM taurine, 5 mM creatine, 0.5 mM EGTA, 20 mM glucose, 5 mM HEPES (pH 7.2)].

substeps.instruction: Dissect the ventricles free from other tissue and cut into small pieces (approx. 2 mm x 2 mm).
Transfer pieces to a small beaker with 5 ml of fresh KB solution and mince with fine scissors.

steps.title: Isolate myocytes
steps.instruction: Gently triturate the minced tissue using a blunt Pasteur pipette and filter through a 500 µm polyester mesh, adding fresh KB solution as needed to facilitate cell release. Collect the filtrate containing the isolated myocytes.

steps.title: Settle and resuspend cells
steps.instruction: Allow the collected myocytes to settle in KB solution at 37°C for 25 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in fresh KB solution and allow cells to settle once more.

steps.title: Culture cells in MEM
steps.instruction: Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the isolated cells in Minimum Essential Medium (MEM) containing bovine serum albumin (1 mg/ml), 2,3 butanedione monoxime (10 mM), insulin/transferrin/selenium (1X), and penicillin/streptomycin.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the resuspended cells to six-well plates.
Place plates in an incubator for approximately 1 hour.

steps.title: Introduce FRET biosensors
steps.instruction: After cells have settled in the dishes, aspirate the supernatant and replace it with fresh media containing viruses expressing appropriate FRET-based biosensors.

substeps.instruction: Monitor for biosensor expression over the next 48 to 72 hours.
